description: This file defines the LuceneIndexManager class, which manages Lucene search indices, including creation, rebuilding, deletion, document management, and index settings. It interacts with Lucene.Net components and handles geospatial data indexing.

classes.name: LuceneIndexManager
classes.description: Provides methods to manage Lucene indices, including creation, rebuilding, deletion, document operations, and index settings. Implements IIndexManager and IDocumentIndexManager interfaces.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new Lucene index if it does not already exist.

methods.name: RebuildAsync
methods.description: Rebuilds the specified index, removing existing data and recreating it.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if an index with the given full name exists.

methods.name: DeleteDocumentsAsync
methods.description: Deletes documents from an index based on provided document IDs.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateDocumentsAsync
methods.description: Adds or updates documents in the index.

methods.name: DeleteAllDocumentsAsync
methods.description: Deletes all documents from the specified index.

methods.name: GetLastTaskIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the last task ID for indexing operations.

methods.name: SetLastTaskIdAsync
methods.description: Sets the last task ID for indexing operations.

methods.name: CreateLuceneDocument
methods.description: Creates a Lucene Document from a DocumentIndex, including handling geospatial points and various data types.
